headline: Nvidia Launches RTX Spark Laptops With Up to 128GB for AI
dek: The first Arm-and-Blackwell laptops arrive Friday with AI agents preinstalled.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Arm chip with a Blackwell GPU
body: Nvidia is launching the first laptops on its RTX Spark chip this Friday, October 16 (NVIDIA).
According to the company, the platform pairs an Arm processor, a Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory, with 1 petaflop for AI.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: Agents on the first screen
s3.body: According to Nvidia, users pick and install an AI agent when they first turn on the laptop.

points.t: Setting up an agent takes two clicks, a Microsoft manager told The Verge.
Hermes, Perplexity and OpenClaw are among the first (The Verge).
Nvidia says it added a layer called OpenShell and MXC.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: A response to Apple Silicon
body: Engadget calls RTX Spark a direct response to Apple's chips, which have combined Arm, GPU and unified memory since 2020.
It debuts in Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra, among other partner models (Engadget).

stat.cap: of unified memory, according to Nvidia

items.t: The sources give no single price; each maker sets its own.
Nvidia cites Artificial Analysis without publishing full numbers.
The company is holding events worldwide starting Friday.

caption.hook: Nvidia is launching its first RTX Spark laptops this Friday, with up to 128GB of unified memory for local AI.
body: According to Nvidia, the platform pairs an Arm processor, a Blackwell GPU and 1 petaflop for AI workloads. When users first turn on the laptop, they pick an AI agent to install.

Engadget sees RTX Spark as a response to Apple Silicon chips. It debuts in Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra, among other partner models. The sources give no single price, and each manufacturer sets the price of its own laptop. Nvidia also says local model downloads are already five times all of last year.
